explanation: Panama's isthmus bends in an S-shape, so the canal runs roughly north-west to south-east. Panama City, at the Pacific end, lies east of Colón, at the Atlantic end.

claims.text: The Pacific entrance of the Panama Canal, beside Panama City, lies further east than its Atlantic entrance at Colón.
The Isthmus of Panama curves in an S-shape.
The Panama Canal runs roughly from north-west to south-east.
Panama City lies at about 79.5° W and Colón at about 79.9° W.
